products.name: AlphaSense
products.note: Market intelligence AI; financial research; insider information risk; MNPI controls needed

profile_text.body:
AlphaSense describes itself as an AI-powered market intelligence and search platform, offering users the ability to find company insights, market data, and research across more than 500 million documents. The company positions its platform as a decision-support tool for financial and business research, emphasizing what it describes as sentence-level citations and an absence of hallucinations in its AI-generated outputs. Featured users on its site include Recurve Capital and Royalty Pharma, which the company cites as examples of firms using the platform for research efficiency and biopharma due diligence respectively.

AlphaSense's product suite includes features the company calls Smart Synonyms, Expert Insights, and Deep Research, the last of which it describes as providing access to generative AI reasoning models applied across its content library. The company claims to have received the highest possible score across 14 criteria in an unnamed report, which is quoted as describing AlphaSense as having "dominated the market with its vision of marrying premier and exclusive content with domain-specific AI for an end-to-end intelligence and decision-support platform."

The site's held facts classify AlphaSense under Finance and Legal AI, and note that its handling of insider information carries material non-public information, or MNPI, risk, flagging a need for appropriate controls around that category of content.
